reason: E1 provides direct support for ITB nucleation/migration mechanisms in low-SFE metals and from grain boundaries, but the cited evidence (E2-E5) does not address the role of compositional complexity, lattice distortion, or SRO on ITB behavior, nor does it link ITBs to creep in HEA multilayers. The key premise about HEA-specific effects is unsupported.
premises: ITBs can nucleate and migrate in low-SFE metals
Twinning/detwinning can occur via ITB nucleation and migration
ITBs can nucleate from grain boundaries via synchronized partial emission
Creep in particle-strengthened HEA is measurable via stepwise loading
